prompt:
Review two independent proposals in this HTTPX checkout: A removes the
GET-method-change block that drops Content-Length and Transfer-Encoding from
BaseClient._redirect_headers; B removes the GET-method-change early return from
BaseClient._redirect_stream so it always returns request.stream. Do not combine
the proposals. Are these redundant legacy treatments that can now be removed?

Verify current, A-only and B-only behavior through an actual Client following
redirects with MockTransport. For each variant, observe the second request's
method, body bytes, Content-Length and Transfer-Encoding for three cases:
POST with b"payload" followed by 302; POST with iter([b"pay", b"load"]) followed
by 302; and POST with b"payload" followed by 307. Use local synthetic URLs,
record actual values and explain each proposal's compatibility consequence.
Do not claim MockTransport observations demonstrate actual network framing.

Trace both code regions through local Git history. Check the claim that these
behaviors were first introduced by the sync-API reintroduction refactor: inspect
the relevant attributed change and an earlier implementation where necessary.
Distinguish line attribution/code movement from behavioral introduction. Citing
earlier presence is sufficient to refute a claimed later introduction; do not
claim first-ever origin or undocumented intent without evidence. Use only
ancestors of the pinned HEAD, not later branch tips or external issue pages.

Give independent recommendations with current call-path and historical evidence.
This is a read-only review: preserve original source/tests/configuration and
installed resources. No network, installs, fetching, commits or publishing.
In-memory substitutions are allowed. Use <PREINSTALLED_PYTHON> with -B for Python
(pytest additionally with -p no:cacheprovider). If scratch is necessary, keep it
inside the project and remove it when done. Captured output is sufficient;
no separate report or retained harness is required.

Work only inside this local repository. Do not use external services or other installed skills. Do not delegate.

capture_diagnostics.limitation: Empty command output may be legitimate. Nonempty output may still be incomplete. These diagnostics neither prove full tool-output capture nor score task success.

pre_collection_index.artifact_scope: Local raw artifact; binary index is not included by exporter
